integrity: Proof and sharpness example supplied in full; the classical Hermite--Biehler interlacing theorem is clearly credited. No claim of independent certification or publication priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Independent summands with outcomes 0, one half, and 1; both parity conditioning events must have positive probabilities.
The sharp bound is for modes of the two conditional distributions, not for the unconditional interlaced distribution.
The finite exact-arithmetic checker is corroboration, not an exhaustive proof over uncountably many parameters and arbitrary numbers of trials.
Related unindexed statements and equivalent classical corollaries cannot be ruled out by targeted literature searches.
title: Sharp \(3/2\) separation of parity-conditioned modes for Poisson-trinomial sums
